purpose: reviewed, anonymized runtime assets for a conservative read-only test build
source_reference_policy: source_id/source_session only; absolute paths are forbidden
privacy: templates may contain tile crops only; no full frames, player UI, nickname, avatar, or room number
test_build_scope: stable hand/draw_visual/gold snapshots only; low-confidence or unsupported classes return UNKNOWN; no automatic UI action
draw_semantics: draw_visual joins the concealed multiset once when first trusted; after a confirmed discard, HAND_RESORTING is visual-only and never adds the tile again; direct discard of draw_visual skips resort; static ROI observations never directly mutate GameState
runtime_known_session_policy: exclude current source_session from template training when session is supplied

concealed_identity_coverage.note: Class coverage is complete, but per-class confidence and cross-session gates still apply.
